"""Seeded checkout session: the page of THIS checkout in a fresh Chromium context with a
fixed locale, time zone and scale (the cart is seeded at $100 by api.js)."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

PAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "checkout.html"
ERROR, TOTAL = "[data-testid=coupon-error]", "[data-testid=order-total]"


@pytest.fixture
def checkout():
    """open(width, height) -> a page on the seeded checkout."""
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser = pw.chromium.launch()

        def open_page(width=1280, height=800):
            context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": width, "height": height},
                                          device_scale_factor=1, locale="en-US",
                                          timezone_id="UTC")
            page = context.new_page()
            page.goto(PAGE.as_uri())
            return page

        yield open_page
        browser.close()


def apply_code(page, code):
    page.fill("#coupon", code)
    page.click("#apply")
